text: Hello my name is Mega Pau and I'm a developer at Bear Brown and Company I'm excited to introduce to you the community resource guide a comprehensive tool we created to support the residents of Durham North Carolina this app helps users locate essential services such as Healthcare education and emergency assistance making an invaluable resource especially for those in underserved communities our app features an intuitive chat system powered by open AI API delivering natural and perative responses to users queries we integrated hugging faces advanced search capabilities ensuring the users receive precise and relevant information quickly as users input their questions the chatbot provides a cured list of

Resources including detail contact information and direct links making it easy to connect with the services they need the Chapa also supports multiple languages ensuring that the language is never a barrier to accessing essential Services currently hosted on stream the app is designed to work seamlessly on both web and mobile platforms ensuring users can access important information anytime anywhere with sufficient funding we plan to transition to a more robust platform to enhance performance and scalability the community resource guide is here to empower residents by making essential Services more accessible and easier to navigate thank you for taking the time to explore this Innovative tool with us
